verdict.rationale: Superset documents orchestrating third-party CLI agents in isolated worktrees, reviewing diffs, and creating PRs. Nothing in the pack shows Superset itself generating tests, running them, or gating proposals on test results. Any testing would come from the hosted agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.) or from user-defined setup scripts, which are host or user-side capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent automatically generate and run tests to validate its own code changes before proposing them
